title: Machine Learning Approaches to Decoding Topological Quantum Codes
abstract: arXiv:2608.15760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoding is an essential component of quantum error correction (QEC), translating stabilizer measurement outcomes into corrective actions that suppress logical errors and preserve logical quantum information. Building fault-tolerant architectures requires increasing the code distance, which in turn places growing demands on decoding accuracy, scalability, and practical deployability. While a wide range of decoding algorithms have been proposed and demonstrated, achieving reliable, scalable, and real-time decoding remains a significant challenge. Machine-learning (ML) approaches are particularly well suited to this setting, as quantum error decoding is fundamentally a problem of processing large volumes of classical data with complex spatiotemporal correlations. translated_title: 机器学习方法在拓扑量子码解码中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15760v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：解码是量子纠错（QEC）中必不可少的组成部分，它将稳定器测量结果转换为抑制逻辑错误并保护逻辑量子信息的纠正操作。构建容错架构需要增加码距，这反过来对解码的准确性、可扩展性和实际部署能力提出了更高要求。尽管已经提出并演示了多种解码算法，但实现可靠、可扩展且实时的解码仍然是一个重大挑战。机器学习（ML）方法特别适合这一场景，因为量子错误解码本质上是一个处理具有复杂时空相关性的大量经典数据的问题。本章综述了基于机器学习的量子错误解码方法，重点关注拓扑码，并强调架构原理、实际性能和实际部署。
tldr: 本文综述了机器学习方法在拓扑量子码解码中的应用，重点强调架构设计、实际性能与实时部署，以应对量子纠错中解码准确性和可扩展性的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews machine-learning approaches for decoding topological quantum codes, emphasizing architectural principles, practical performance, and real-time deployment to address key challenges in accuracy and scalability of quantum error correction.
